description: Creates a new Cognigy.AI knowledge connector for automated content ingestion from external sources like SharePoint or Confluence. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to create.

config.description: Connector-specific configuration, including any connection reference the connector requires

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create.

extension.description: Name of the extension that provides the knowledge connector (see list_extensions)

knowledgeStoreId.description: The knowledge store ID to create the connector in

schedule.description: Run schedule. Defaults to disabled (run manually with run_knowledge_connector).

weekDays.description: Days to run on (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday)

type.description: Connector type as defined by the extension

version.description: Version of the extension's connector to use

name: create_knowledge_connector
